newsitem.title: UK: VICKERS UP ON PRESS REPORT OF UNIT SALE.
newsitem.headline: VICKERS UP ON PRESS REPORT OF UNIT SALE.

text.p: Shares in Vickers Group Plc advanced to a five-week high on Monday after a weekend press report said the UK engineering concern was close to completing the sale of its medical systems division, dealers said.
By 1056 GMT, the shares were up 8-1/2p to 207-1/2.
The Independent on Sunday said the move would pave the way to an agreed merger with British Aerospace.
Vickers was not immediately available to comment on the report.
The newspaper said the company was hoping to announce the sale of the division when it publishes its half-year results in September.
Dealers said there had been talk about the sale for several weeks. "I don't know if it would be a huge surprise," said one.

In June the company announced it was to sell its S&W Medico Teknik unit to Sweden's Artema Medical AB. The newspaper said that ever since, observers have been expecting the sale of the remaining businesses, which make incubators and electronic monitoring equipment.
The Independent said while no deal has been concluded, it is understood that one of the leading contenders for the division is Smith Industries, which has extensive healthcare technology interests.
